title: Used the Keepers' pilgrim stair to enter Marrowgate; the game itself said at the time 'The pilgrim stair lets out behind the guards' backs. Nobody has watched it in a hundred years.' The closing recap directly contradicts this by describing the stair as still unopened: 'The Keeper's Key left Barrowmere in a pocket, bound for a pilgrim stair at Coldpass that has not opened in a hundred years' — even though I had just opened and walked it that same session.
where: The Pass Gate / 'climb the Keepers' pilgrim stair' — final status 'how the realm remembers you'
